title: Singapore visa guidance — Indian ordinary passports
text: Official ICA page reviewed 2026-09-27 (page shows updated 2024-03-02). For Indian-issued travel documents, Singapore requires an entry visa; diplomatic, official and service passports are exceptions. The page lists a signed Form 14A, a recent photograph, and a passport biodata copy with at least six months of validity at entry. Applications can go through an authorised agent or overseas mission, or an eligible Singapore local contact/strategic partner. This summary is for Indian passport holders only; other nationalities need a separate official check. Recheck the linked ICA page and embassy before travelling; this is not a determination of individual admission or visa approval.
